# Harness Engineering

A Muse agent skill that designs, builds, verifies, or maintains your assistant's operating setup — memory and instruction files, workspace layout, skills, automations, connectors — from a vague brief or an existing setup. Pick your entry point: Interview, Audit (read-only), Plan, Build (approved changes applied through a helper with dry-run, backups, and rollback), Verify, or Maintain. Approval for one group never approves another; it never installs third-party code, trusts hooks, authenticates accounts, or publishes without separate approval. No account, no API key needed.
